Run GitHub issue intake dry-runs for Issues #7 and #8 without posting private data or creating duplicates.

Audit One Time assets, Drive truth, and UI/source coverage with evidence tied to commit/deployment where possible.
Verify live database, Railway deployment metadata, Drive source IDs, and guarded production backfill only through approved read-only or apply gates.
Implement full canonical persistence, lifecycle, adapters, auto-resume, Operations UI, watchdogs, synthetic E2E, deploy, and live verification.
Produce private ChatGPT return packet and redacted repo summary.
